mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome to this journey where we rediscover the magic and meaning behind the fairy tales we grew up with. Have you ever wondered why those stories stuck with us, or how their fantastical worlds quietly shaped the way we see ourselves and our emotions? Together, let’s explore the insights of Bruno Bettelheim, whose book, The Uses of Enchantment: The Meaning and Importance of Fairy Tales, opens the door to the deeper layers hidden inside our favorite childhood tales. We’ll look at how these stories, with their daring heroes, wicked stepmothers, and magical triumphs, do so much more than just entertain. They help us as children—and even as adults—face our fears, understand our desires, and build resilience and hope along the way. Through Bettelheim’s thoughtful exploration, we’ll see how fairy tales offer a safe space to navigate big feelings, solve problems, and grow from innocence to maturity. So, if you’re ready to see your favorite stories in a whole new light and discover the power they hold for personal growth, let’s step into this world of enchantment together.
